Mille Lacs Lake is a 132,516-acre glacially-formed lake in east-central Minnesota.  Even though most visitors come for the world class fishing, many say the amazing view of such a massive pristine lake is worth the trip alone.  The Mille Lacs Lake game fish population is primarily composed of walleye, yellow perch, northern pike, muskellunge, and smallmouth bass.  Approximately 70 percent of the 85 miles of shoreline consists of suitable walleye spawning habitat.  This makes the lake a virtual factory.  Look no further for a trip of a lifetime.

Many thousands of years ago, glaciers scraped along the continent carving their way through the Alexandria Lakes Area and leaving a landscape with hundreds of lakes, rolling hills and open prairie. The lakes area offers endless possibilities for family fun and incredible fishing.  Whether you’re looking for a lake that’s full of life and close to town or one that’s peaceful and off the beaten path, Alexandria truly has something for everyone.

We offer full day and half day trips. The rates are based on a minimum of two anglers per boat.  Our boats can comfortably and safely fish up to four clients.  If you have additional people that would like to ride along to experience the fun there would be an additional fee of $50 per person (up to 6 total people). We work with a number of other top guides across the state, so if you have a larger group of 5-15 people we can certainly accommodate you.

This is your day so let us know if you have any special requests and we’ll do everything we can to accommodate you!

Full Day Trips are 8 hours.
Half Day Trips are 4 hours.

What we Provide:

All top of the line equipment. From the boat to the bait, we cut no corners. This is your day on the water and we want it to be the best it can possibly be!

All guide boats are 18′ – 20′ tiller fishing boats.  Joe’s boat is a 20′ Ranger tiller with a 115 Yamaha motor.  This boat fishes 3 clients very comfortably, but will allow fishing for up to 4-5 clients.  The boat is equipped with Minn Kota trolling motors and Lowrance electronics. All rods and reels are also premium quality.

All gas, bait and tackle for the day will be provided.

If you desire to keep fish, we will gladly clean and bag them for you.

What you should bring:

Current Minnesota Fishing License. (Buy MN fishing license here)
Proper clothing for the weather: Jacket, hat, raingear, etc.
Note: It can feel much colder on the water.
Camera
Sunscreen
Drinks and Snacks
Cooler with ice for fish, if you desire to keep any.

content.rendered: Hello my name is Joe Scegura and welcome to my site. I was born and raised in the Central Minnesota area. I have been addicted to fishing for as long as I can remember. When all the other kids were playing ball, I was driving my bike two miles to the lake near my home to fish. I bought my first boat when I was 13 years old, and I’ve fished just about every day since. I’ve long since sold that boat and now run a twenty foot Ranger with a 150 Yamaha. This tiller boat, along with my extensive knowledge of Central Minnesota, ensures you a comfortable and productive day on the water that you won’t soon forget. My favorite methods of fishing include: live bait rigging, bobber fishing, trolling spinners, and pulling crank baits. I love “talking fish”, so I’m more than willing to answer any questions you might have about any type of fishing. Give me a call or shoot me an email anytime, I’m always ready to fish!

Welcome to Joe Scegura’s Guide Service

Do you like to fish? Would you like to learn how to catch more fish? Or maybe your free time is limited and you just don’t have time to find the fish on your own?

From experienced fishing enthusiast to novice angler, you will have nothing short of a great time fishing with us.

Joe Scegura’s Guide Service offers guided fishing trips across Central Minnesota, primarily on Alexandria area lakes, Mille Lacs Lake, and the northern part of the Mississippi River. We fish all species, but specialize in walleye. Whether you are looking to hone a special technique, learn the basics, or just catch some fish…give us a call!
